[NCBK.6.1] The `call` action issues an async request to a service the integrator
owns (an HA service call, an MQTT publish, a weather request — anything a rule needs done outside libds that may yield a typed reply).

The callback type is `ds_call_cb_t`, its payload `ds_call_request_t`, and it is registered by `ds_engine_set_call_callback` — all declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`.
